title: HyperFlow H3 Flash text to video with Deno
description: Create video from a prompt with HyperFlow H3 Flash, with an optional Deno tiled finish.

controls.label: Keep face (one person through head turns)

requirements.name: HyperFlowGGUFLoader
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed HyperFlow H3 Flash loader on the local worker.

requirements.name: HyperFlowSigmas
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed HyperFlow sampler schedule.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_fl2va_hyperflow_flash_14b-Q4_K_M.gguf
requirements.instructions: Add the HyperFlow H3 Flash FL2VA Q4 model to the worker's GGUF model list.

requirements.name: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 text encoder.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 video VAE.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

requirements.name: DenoMiniMaxH3TiledSampler
requirements.instructions: Install the separately reviewed Deno tiled sampler on the local worker.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler.

requirements.name: KSamplerSelect
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing KSamplerSelect.

requirements.name: SplitSigmas
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SplitSigmas.

requirements.name: SamplerLCM
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SamplerLCM.

requirements.name: SamplerCustom
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SamplerCustom.

requirements.name: ConditioningZeroOut
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing ConditioningZeroOut.

evidence: Official HyperFlow text-to-video API template. Local CreativeField API acceptance: six steps, 768 × 768, muted output; generated content visually inspected. Audio generation and other sizes remain unqualified.

licenses.software: ComfyUI HyperFlow Flash custom nodes: GPL-3.0. Sampling: native-node variant of H3 Image EasyFix (method shared by Reddit user barbear22).

weights.name: HyperFlow H3 Flash and MiniMax H3 components
